coverage: Visited the link once in an isolated CreateOS sandbox with a headless browser (read-only, no form submission).
Network access limited to 1 validated host; egress policy read back and bypass probe blocked.
Checked title, branding, 1 form, redirect chain and page text signals.
limitations: A single visit can miss content shown only to some visitors, devices, or countries.
No interaction was performed (no clicks, no typing), so later steps of a scam are not observed.
